body_markdown: Mr. Bogle has served as a member of our Board of Directors since November 2026. Mr. Bogle served as Chief Executive Officer of Epizyme, Inc. from 2021 until its acquisition by Ipsen in 2022. He was Senior Vice President and Chief Commercial Officer of TESARO from 2015 until its acquisition by GlaxoSmithKline in 2019. Earlier, he served as Senior Vice President of Pharmaceutical and Biotech Solutions at McKesson Specialty Health/U.S. Oncology and Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing at Millennium Pharmaceuticals. Mr. Bogle earned a B.A. in Economics from Dartmouth College, an MBA from Columbia University and was a 2020 Fellow in the Advanced Leadership Initiative at Harvard University.
